title: Transit Allowed for a Vehicle that Has Been Recovered
content:
A vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing that has been recovered is allowed transit miles against the booked stretch, and what is counted is the completed Keyturn Roadside Assistance callouts in the rolling twelve months counted back from the handling date.

| Completed Keyturn Roadside Assistance callouts in the window | Allowed against the booked stretch |
| --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 80 miles |
| exactly 1 | 40 miles |
| none | 0 miles |

As clauses: a vehicle with two or more completed Keyturn Roadside Assistance callouts in the rolling twelve months counted back from the handling date is allowed 80 miles of recovery transit against the booked stretch; one with exactly one completed callout in that window is allowed 40 miles; and one with no completed callout in that window is allowed none on this ground.

A callout that was not completed is not counted, and a callout dated thirteen months back falls outside the window.
